mapper.select: SELECT id, order_no, user_id, payment_no, CASE payment_method WHEN 1 THEN 'ALIPAY' WHEN 2 THEN 'WECHAT' WHEN 3 THEN 'BANK_CARD' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END as payment_method, payment_amount, CASE status WHEN 0 THEN 'PENDING' WHEN 1 THEN 'SUCCESS' WHEN 2 THEN 'FAILED' WHEN 3 THEN 'CLOSED' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END as status, created_time, updated_time FROM payment WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_time DESC

SELECT id, order_no, user_id, payment_no, CASE payment_method WHEN 1 THEN 'ALIPAY' WHEN 2 THEN 'WECHAT' WHEN 3 THEN 'BANK_CARD' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END as payment_method, payment_amount, CASE status WHEN 0 THEN 'PENDING' WHEN 1 THEN 'SUCCESS' WHEN 2 THEN 'FAILED' WHEN 3 THEN 'CLOSED' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END as status, created_time, updated_time FROM payment WHERE id = #{id}
